comment: Picked up well en route to being nicely on top at the finish in Windsor event; promising
race_name: Soil Association 80th Anniversary Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 90,000euros yearling; Sioux Nation half-sister to four winners; picked up well from the back and was nicely on top at the finish in Windsor event (6f, good to firm); promising filly.

comment: Got on top towards the finish in Ascot contest and looks a plausible Royal Ascot hope
race_name: Soil Association 80th Anniversary Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 60,000gns yearling; Lucky Vega half-brother to five winners; got on top towards the finish in Ascot contest (6f, good) and looks a plausible Royal Ascot hope; respected.

comment: AW winner who seems to face a stiffer task back on turf but may progress again
owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
race_name: Soil Association 80th Anniversary Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: Dark Angel colt; made all at Kempton (6f, AW) to step up on his Newmarket effort (5f); appears to face a stiffer task back on turf but may be capable of further progress.

comment: Promising second, from the front, at Newmarket on 1,000 Guineas day; leading contender
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: Trainer rode this filly's dam to Listed 2yo success during his riding days; promising half-length second of eight, from the front, in Newmarket event (5f, good to firm) on 1,000 Guineas day; leading contender.

comment: £105,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Persian Force and descends from a 6f 2yo Group 2 winner
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: 82,000euros yearling, £105,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; Persian Force half-sister to 6f AW winner Jorge Alvares (RPR 97); dam unraced, is granddaughter of 6f 2yo Group 2 scorer; major stable; good credentials.

comment: Penalty for narrow win at Newmarket is partly offset by Mason Paetel's useful claim
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: The offspring of two winners for her owner; prevailed only narrowly at the Newmarket Craven meeting (5f, good) but is open to progress and a penalty is partly offset by Mason Paetel's useful 5lb claim.

comment: £105,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Blue Point out of 5f 2yo scorer; likely type
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: £62,000 yearling, £105,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; Blue Point half-sister to three winners, notably Showtime Mahomes (5f-7f including 2yo/AW; RPR 85); dam 5f AW 2yo scorer (72); likely type.

comment: Beaten favourite in two AW events, nevertheless showing ability; may still do better
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: Beaten favourite in a couple of 5f AW contests, nevertheless showing ability, last time second behind the subsequent Marygate (Listed) winner; may still do better and it remains too early to write her off.

comment: Attractively bred, by Blue Point out of a 6f 2yo winner (on debut) for her owner
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: Attractively bred newcomer, by Blue Point out of a 6f 2yo winner (on debut; later Group placed; RPR 97) for her owner; interesting, especially if the market speaks positively.

comment: Showed some promise with third of six, best of the newcomers, in Salisbury conditions race
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: Showed some promise with third of six, best of the newcomers, in Salisbury conditions race (5f, good to firm) won by quite a useful sort (Listed placed since); not difficult to envisage her going well.

comment: 42,000euros yearling; Caturra half-sister to three winners; market informative
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: 17,000gns foal, 42,000euros yearling; Caturra half-sister to three winners, notably King Cuan (Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo; RPR 112); dam 7f AW/7.5f turf scorer (85); market informative.

comment: 18,000euros yearling; Lucky Vega half-sister to two winners; check the betting
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
spotlight: 18,000euros yearling; Lucky Vega half-sister to two winners, notably Son Of Corballis (5f 2yo including Listed; RPR 93); dam related to two UAE Oaks winners; check the betting.

comment: Can set pace; unraced beyond 1m4f on Flat but can't be comfortably dismissed in this field
race_name: Track Radio Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Acts on soft; can make the running; won six (four over hurdles, two on Flat) of seven starts in a golden spell last February-October; soundly beaten over hurdles on latest three outings (in tough races on last two) and unraced beyond 1m4f on Flat, but he can't be comfortably dismissed in this small field.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Give It To Me Oj', 'horse_id': 5900733, 'quote': "He really got things together over hurdles last winter and finished the season well when winning under top weight at Sandown on finals day. As expected, he was well handicapped back on the Flat, winning twice at Epsom over the summer and he might yet go for the November Handicap. He's a big horse who was always going to do better with time, and his quality got him through when winning from the front at Cheltenham on Saturday. He'll be better than that over hurdles, and there's a Grade 3 for four-year-olds at Fairyhouse at the end of November to consider, although the Gerry Feilden at Newbury is more likely. Beyond that, what was the Betfair Hurdle in February is the sort of stiff test he wants and the County Hurdle might suit him at the end of the season. He's a proper horse to run over hurdles. 28-10-25"}]

comment: Raced freely but close, never-nearer 3rd over C&D (good) on return was more improved form
race_name: Track Radio Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Usually held up; third in a 2yo maiden was his sole run on softer than good; can race freely but showed improved form when upped to 2m for wins at Kempton (AW) and Nottingham (good) in his final two runs last season, and he continued on his upward curve when a close, never-nearer third of seven over C&D (good) three weeks ago; retains potential.

comment: Fifth of 12 at Newmarket (1m6f) last time was respectable but settling him was an issue
owner: J William Rowley & S P C Woods
race_name: Track Radio Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Unraced on softer than good when on turf; made immediate progress when switched to AW in the autumn, completing a hat-trick in a 1m4f novice and 1m4f/1m6f handicaps; perhaps in need of the race (albeit joint-favourite) on reappearance last month and fifth of 12 at Newmarket (1m6f) four weeks later was respectable, but settling him was an issue; suitability for a slog over 2m can therefore be questioned.

comment: AW has dominated career; best turf ratings on last two outings but still needs better
race_name: Track Radio Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Very busy and he's had his share of wins, including four over 2m in 2025, but that's been mostly on AW which has dominated his career; best turf ratings were on last two outings but his turf form still needs improvement.

comment: 1st and 2nd in his last two Kempton AW starts; good chance if that form is transferred
race_name: Track Radio Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Close third on soft at Yarmouth (1m6f) last July was his best turf form; needs better given the improvement he's shown on Kempton AW (2m) in two of his three starts since, but he'd have a good chance if that form is transferred back to turf; won on 2024 reappearance; needs a close look.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Caprelo', 'horse_id': 5366273, 'quote': "He's got the ability and last season he won first time out at Kempton and was second twice, but he's become disappointing. He was favourite last time at Kempton, where he finished fifth, and I'm afraid Ulysses's progeny can be a bit reluctant to put their best feet forward. He runs at Kempton again on Wednesday. 29-05-25"}]

comment: Made all at Ascot on handicap/seasonal debut and looks the type to progress further
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Made all at Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) on handicap/seasonal debut, building on her 2yo efforts, and looks the type to progress further; bred to be suited by this longer distance; upped in class but receives plenty of weight all round; shortlisted.

comment: Well treated under a penalty (future mark 1lb higher) and may improve further to boot
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Unraced on soft/heavy; appeared to have something in hand at Windsor (11.5f) last week on seasonal debut, taking turf record to 2-3 and overall strike-rate to 4-7; back up two grades but looks well treated under a penalty (future mark 1lb higher) and won over C&D last August; may improve further to boot; respected.

comment: Steadily progressive last term, building up a solid record that featured three wins
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Yet to race on soft/heavy ground; steadily progressive last term, building up a solid record that featured three wins; good third at Newmarket final outing; cheekpieces worn the last twice are now removed; likely to go well.

comment: Held her form well last year for Richard Hughes; sold for 70,000gns since last run
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Trained last year by Richard Hughes, winning on debut then holding her form well, including two creditable efforts at Goodwood; sold for 70,000gns since last run; the betting may help to ascertain expectations on stable/seasonal debut.

comment: Has form figures of 112 when racing below Listed/Group level
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Well beaten in the Lingfield Oaks Trial most recently but is somewhat interesting back down in grade, being a filly who has form figures of 112 when racing below Listed/Group level; ran well in Doncaster handicap (1m2f) the final time.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Amora Queen', 'horse_id': 7657435, 'quote': "She's a huge, scopey filly and was probably achieving ahead of her time last year. We bit off more than we could chew in the Fillies' Mile and an Oaks entry is probably ambitious at this stage, but she should stay very well and it wouldn't be a huge surprise if she improved enough over middle distances to be up to having a shot at something like that. The tentative route would be to reappear in a fillies' handicap at Doncaster on Saturday, or the slightly more ambitious route would be the Cheshire Oaks. She showed a good level of ability at two and has always looked like she'll be much better at three, which is quite exciting. She's wintered very well and had a racecourse gallop at the Craven meeting. 21-04-26"}]

comment: Absent since creditable second in last year's November Handicap on stable debut
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Five-time winner, including over C&D; absent since creditable second in last year's November Handicap at Doncaster on debut for new yard; hit with another rise in the weights but drops back in class and may remain competitive.

comment: Three-time AW scorer; below par returned to turf last time; this is harder
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Three-time AW scorer; turf form features two good efforts but she's 0-4 in this sphere and was below par at Doncaster most recently; not the percentage call in this warmer contest.

comment: Consistent AW handicapper; faces difficult task off current mark back on turf
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Consistent AW handicapper and a seven-time winner in that sphere; only 1-9 on turf and appears to have a difficult task off current mark, especially in this grade, returned to this sphere.

comment: Has a doubt over current form and is the oldest and most exposed contender
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Ended her 2025 campaign with an August win but hasn't been in anything like the same form since returning to action and is the most exposed, as well as the oldest, contender in this field.

comment: Lightly raced; may do better still; a possible danger, provided she stays new trip
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Stablemate of Orionis; lightly raced 5yo who wasn't disgraced on handicap debut (1m2f; kept to AW) when last seen; showed promise on debut in sole turf attempt and may do better still; possible danger, provided she stays the new trip.

comment: Creditable third in Chester Group 2 upped to 1m2f last time; unexposed at this trip
owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Won the Celebration Mile at Goodwood in 2024; creditable third, faring best of the runners who came off steady pace, in Group 2 at Chester (good) upped to 1m2f last time; unexposed at this distance and enters calculations despite carrying a 3lb penalty for Listed success (1m, soft) last autumn.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Ice Max', 'horse_id': 5021313, 'quote': "A solid horse who finished off last season really well. A free-going type who doesn't always settle, he saw out his last two races well and will hopefully carry on in that vein. He wants soft ground and we'll probably start him off over a mile. 31-03-26"}]

comment: Smart performer whose strong CV features two Royal Ascot wins; major contender
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Has form on all types of ground; smart performer whose strong CV includes wins in the Vintage Stakes at Goodwood as a 2yo and two Royal Ascot contests, more recently last year's Wolferton (1m2f Listed); best figures give him a major chance at the weights.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Haatem', 'horse_id': 5021365, 'quote': "He's been a real star for us, winning at Royal Ascot for the last two seasons, so we'll try to get a race into him before heading there again, although I may just do it with a couple of racecourse gallops. The Wolferton will be his target again. He showed he got the trip when winning it last year, so we'll work back from that. He's sound, honest, versatile and very good. 21-04-26"}]

comment: Respected on ratings and is a similar type to last year's winner (for same connections)
owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Defied top weight in the 2025 Cambridgeshire (1m1f, good to firm) and holds a leading chance provided that smart handicap form is reproduced; hasn't transferred it back to Group level this term but he's respected on ratings and is a similar type to last year's winner of this race (for same connections).
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Boiling Point', 'horse_id': 5005614, 'quote': "Won the Cambridgeshire last year with a really solid performance. We stepped him up in trip in the Winter Derby and while I think he gets a mile and a quarter, the track didn't suit. He could go for the Earl of Sefton at Newmarket next. 31-03-26"}, {'horse': 'Boiling Point', 'horse_id': 5005614, 'quote': "He has always looked a nice colt and I expected him to go well on his debut, which he did when finishing second to Cogitate at Newbury over 7f. That did him a lot of good and we sent him back there over a mile on Friday, when he finished third. We'll have to sit down and see where he goes next. 25-08-23"}]

comment: Ties in with Haatem on 2025 Royal Ascot running; returns from ten-month layoff
owner: T & Mrs L Standish & Mrs A Spence
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Unlucky second at Glorious Goodwood in 2024 when bidding for a notable 1m2f handicap double; best effort in a truncated 2025 campaign when fourth to Haatem in Listed grade at Royal Ascot; should be thereabouts, provided he's in top form after ten-month layoff.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Enfjaar', 'horse_id': 4607023, 'quote': "We trained him for the Wolferton last season and he was unlucky not to win. He looks as good as ever and he's likely to start back in the Listed Festival Stakes at Goodwood in May. How he goes there will dictate his early-season programme. If he wasn't to win, he could go back to the Wolferton, but if he won at Goodwood we might be more ambitious. He hasn't been over-raced and is a lovely older horse to have around. 01-04-26"}]

comment: His most promising runs are not forgotten and it's too soon to give up on him; new trip
owner: Halo Racing N Greenhalgh J Degenhardt
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Unlucky second in last year's Britannia at Royal Ascot then caught the eye on reappearance; hasn't exactly lived up to expectations in two starts since but remains of interest assuming this new scenario (steps up from 1m) prompts a positive effect; too soon to give up on him.

comment: Had the run of the race when 33-1 winner of similar event over C&D last September
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Performed well twice over C&D last term but had the run of the race when belying his 33-1 odds for neck success at Listed level in September (good to soft) and looks no certainty to defy a 3lb penalty back here, unless things again fall his way.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Naqeeb', 'horse_id': 4001911, 'quote': "We really like him. He was third at Royal Ascot in the Duke of Edinburgh and we were thrilled with him as it showed he has a good race in him, but he just got too far back in the John Smith's Cup at York last time and you've got to put a line through that and move on from it. We'll try to see if we can get him to the 1m2f handicap at Goodwood next Tuesday. We're not discouraged from trying him again over that trip. He's more or less run every two or three weeks of late, so it just depends on what he's telling us. He's a nice horse to have. 23-07-25"}]

comment: Retains plenty of ability but has something to find back on home soil
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Missed 2025; last two performances, namely success at Meydan (handicap) and third at Longchamp (Listed), show that he retains plenty of ability; however, has something to find back on home soil.

comment: Age may be catching up with him; hasn't won a domestic race since 2023
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Multiple winner down the years but 2025 figures suggest age may be catching up with him to some degree; hasn't won a domestic race since 2023 and it's an even longer time since he made a successful seasonal debut.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Certain Lad', 'horse_id': 1996397, 'quote': "He had a great season last year, winning a Listed race and a Group 3 in France. He had a very small setback after his Group win, which prevented us from having a crack at some of the big ones, but he'll be campaigned at the top level. There's no point running him with penalties in Group 3s this year. We're going to take a punt to see if we can land a big one. He'll go for the Prix d'Harcourt at Longchamp on Sunday, all being well, with a view to then going for the Prix Ganay. He'll have entries in the Prince of Wales's and all those other races, and if one cuts up he's that high-level horse who could pick up the pieces. He seems to be training well and he's our flagbearer, and we hope he can win some more stakes races this year. 02-04-25"}]

comment: Record of 0-5 since debut win but he's useful and ran creditably in sole C&D attempt
race_name: Fitzdares Festival Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Record of 0-5 since debut win (Wood Ditton) but he's useful and ran creditably in sole C&D attempt, namely fourth to Naqeeb in Listed event; could go well with Chester (Group 2) reappearance under his belt.

comment: Took well to cheekpieces last time and may have more to offer in the retained headgear
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Took well to first-time cheekpieces at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) returned to turf with AW reappearance under his belt, taking overall record to 3-13; upped in grade but may have more to offer in the retained headgear; shortlisted.

comment: May resume progress with AW reappearance under his belt; should take well to Goodwood
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Unraced on soft/heavy; scored four times on turf last term and may resume his progress with creditable AW reappearance under his belt; combined record of 3-4 at Epsom and Brighton bodes well for this first visit to Goodwood, which is quite similar to those tracks; highly respected.

comment: Chance partly depends on how well he responds to removal of usual cheekpieces
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Useful on his day but losing run is mounting up and two duck eggs this year leave a question mark over his current form; chance partly depends on how well he responds to the removal of usual cheekpieces.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Oliver Show', 'horse_id': 4607031, 'quote': "He was meant to come back for the Lincoln but got stuck in Bahrain, where he was completely outpaced over six furlongs in January. He could go to the Guineas meeting if he gets back in time, then maybe go for this month's Spring Cup at Newbury. 02-04-26"}]

comment: Low-mileage 5yo who looks interesting back up in trip; further progress is still possible
owner: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo who has gained both wins (7f/1m) on good to firm; grabbed third place on line over 6f for an encouraging reappearance effort and looks interesting back up in distance, with further improvement still a possibility.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Walsons Law', 'horse_id': 6088048, 'quote': "He won at Windsor this month but I backed him up a bit quick - the handicapper notched him up 9lb, so I thought I had to run under a penalty. That last run was at Kempton but I don't think he's as good on the all-weather as he is on turf. So we'll give him a bit of time and then we'll find another race for him, maybe back at Windsor. 02-07-25"}]

comment: Latest effort shows he retains full ability aged eight; may remain competitive
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Went close at Musselburgh (7f, good) last time, showing he retains full ability aged eight; dual winner at Goodwood and may remain competitive; gained last three wins on soft ground.

comment: Best form at 7f on good/firmer; chance may depend on the actions of the weather
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Best form at 7f on good/firmer; completed a hat-trick last summer and ran creditably in big field at Newmarket in the first of his two starts this term; chance may depend on the actions of the weather, however.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Crimson Spirit', 'horse_id': 4924738, 'quote': "He ran really well on his reappearance at York. He's a lovely, big, scopey gelding with lots to look forward to as the season progresses. He handles any track, he's versatile and he's a fun horse who should be winning more races. We're looking at Salisbury for him on Sunday. 11-06-25"}]

comment: Unfavourable draw played a part in him failing to transfer AW form back to turf last time
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Record of 3-5 on AW includes two stylish wins over 7f at Southwell for new yard; unfavourable draw played a part in him failing to transfer the form back to turf in the Victoria Cup when admittedly taking record in this sphere to 0-6.

comment: Not beaten entirely by 7.5f trip on reappearance but is still seeking first win beyond 6f
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Didn't seem beaten entirely by the 7.5f trip at Chester on seasonal debut but is still seeking a first success beyond sprint distances; not exactly guaranteed to take advantage of being 1lb below last winning mark.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Solar Aclaim', 'horse_id': 5279949, 'quote': "He won well at Chester last time. He's useful on soft ground but is very ground dependent. He's in the Stewards' Cup but won't run unless the ground is right for him, so he's the opposite to Indian Run, who won't run if it's too soft. 23-07-25"}]

comment: Chance of doubling his tally largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Has been unable to sustain early progress and is 0-7 since debut success; ran respectably on penultimate start and is on a reduced mark but chance of doubling his tally largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Al Arbeed', 'horse_id': 5845546, 'quote': "He'd have needed his first race of the season, but I was a bit disappointed with his next at Musselburgh. Perhaps the undulations didn't suit him, and he wasn't drawn all that well, so don't judge him on that because I think he'll make his mark in decent handicaps. I may put some headgear on him next time. 21-04-26"}]

comment: Form dipped returned to turf last time; hasn't scored in this sphere since his 2yo days
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Previously effective on turf but form dipped returned to this sphere last time and he still hasn't scored on grass since his 2yo days; admittedly on a workable mark provided he rebounds.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'The Dragon King', 'horse_id': 5764774, 'quote': "He had a really successful two-year-old season last year, winning three times, including the big sales race at Newmarket on his final run. He grew a little bit over the winter and we're pleased with what we're seeing. 17-04-25"}]

comment: Pair of duck eggs this term don't tell the whole story; record of 1211 over 7f previously
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Produced form figures of 1211 once upped to 7f last term; has posted two duck eggs this season but raced further back than usual on reappearance and was unfavourably drawn in the Victoria Cup latest; may prove resurgent.

comment: Returns to his ideal sphere but brings a question mark over current form
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Returns to his ideal sphere (turf) but brings a question mark over his current form, having trailed home last in both AW outings this year; possibly out of his depth to boot, having never won above Class 4.

comment: Still needs to prove her best AW form can be transferred back to turf
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Similar type to Shiplake, with still having to prove that best AW form can be transferred back to turf; not exactly solid on 2026 efforts anyway and doesn't look the percentage call in this competitive field.

comment: Three duck eggs since 2024; needs to prove he retains ability; second run for new yard
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Showed notable handicap form in 2024 but has posted duck eggs in three runs since that campaign and needs to prove he retains ability; best watched on second run for new yard, unless the market suggests otherwise.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Metal Merchant', 'horse_id': 4175410, 'quote': "He won the Spring Cup at Newbury last year and ran some really creditable races in the top handicaps for the rest of the season. He seems to have come back from his winter break in good shape and he's training really well. We initially thought about the Lincoln, but I think we'll go back to Newbury for the Spring Cup again. He'll campaign in those big mile handicaps. He ran well for a long way in the Royal Hunt Cup at Royal Ascot and all those types of races will be on his agenda. We hope he can pick up one of them. 02-04-25"}]

comment: Good spell around this time last year; possibilities if taking well to refitted blinkers
owner: Mrs J Woods And K Lawrence
race_name: Edward Bulmer Natural Paint Handicap
spotlight: Had bad luck in running over C&D during an otherwise successful spell around this time last year; inconsistent since but has possibilities off current mark provided he takes to refitted blinkers (worn once previously, as a 2yo).
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Rare Change', 'horse_id': 5708625, 'quote': "We've always held him in high regard and he ran a blinder at Glorious Goodwood when third in a 6f nursery. Oisin Murphy felt he may have ridden him wrong on the day but he competed well in a very good nursery. He was only sixth at Doncaster last Friday, so he's frustrating, but talented, and we're going to have to figure out how to win with him. 18-09-24"}]

comment: On two-year losing spell but is on a very attractive mark and drops in class
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Acts on any ground; on a losing spell that goes back to Group 3 success two years ago but is on a very attractive mark and his Class 2 form this term includes a couple of respectable efforts; this combination of a drop in grade and assistance of Jamie Spencer (up for first time; regular jockey for the owner) may be the time to catch him.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Seven Questions', 'horse_id': 5048131, 'quote': "He ran an absolute blinder at Chester the other day when fourth behind Roman Dragon - he showed phenomenal speed from the inside gate, which he needed to do, and tanked along beautifully. I'm going to keep him quite busy - I think he's very well handicapped and if he does win a handicap - which I'm sure he will - he could then go on and win one or two quite cosily. He's frighteningly well handicapped and will be dangerous in any race he shows up in. He runs at Goodwood on Friday. 20-05-26"}]

comment: Won at Ripon on stable/seasonal debut and remains well treated on peak form
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Regained the winning thread at Ripon (5f, good) on stable/seasonal debut when 5lb lower and rider took off 7lb; this seems a harder task but he remains well treated on peak form and is a dual winner at Goodwood; enters calculations.

comment: 0-7 for current yard but has two pieces of encouraging form this year; possibilities
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who is 0-7 for current yard but has two pieces of encouraging form this year, namely placed efforts at Meydan and Newmarket on good ground (perhaps ideally suited by softer); below par last time but otherwise has possibilities.

comment: Went close at Nottingham last time; again gets weight all round; may remain competitive
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Has registered two wins apiece on AW and turf; went close at Nottingham (5f, good) most recently; again receives weight all round and may well remain competitive; has bits of C&D form.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Nogos Dream', 'horse_id': 4175313, 'quote': "Some people don't like him but I love him. If every horse in the yard was second nearly every time they ran you'd be happy. He's a bit quirky and we took all the gear off him for Sandown on Saturday, when he finished fourth after getting no luck in running. But that's Nogo, you have to ride him for luck and we didn't get it. He's ultra-consistent and it's just about finding the key to him. 18-09-24"}]

comment: Went close at Beverley on penultimate start; paid for racing freely in cheekpieces latest
owner: M McHale J Munroe M Guy & D Walshe
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Did well last term, winning four times; went close at Beverley on penultimate start and paid for racing freely in cheekpieces a few days later; runs without the headgear this time and could go well.

comment: Not disgraced back on turf last time but took his record in this sphere to 0-9
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Record of 6-17 on AW includes two wins in a consistent 2026 campaign; not disgraced back on turf last time but finished only fifth of six and took record in this sphere to 0-9; others preferred.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Fidelius', 'horse_id': 5237783, 'quote': "He's had a wonderful winter - he's been absolutely superb with three wins and three seconds and has kept the flag flying for us. Although he hasn't won on the turf yet, he's had some good placed efforts. At the moment he just needs to bounce back from a run at Bath the other day that didn't really work out for him, but I think he'll be winning again and hopefully on the turf as well. 20-05-26"}]

comment: Needs to prove he can transfer AW form back to turf; mark has gone up in tandem
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Prevailed in reapplied hood at Southwell (6f) last time, taking AW record to 4-13; needs to prove he can transfer the form back to turf; only 1-10 in this sphere and is 7lb higher than last attempt.

comment: Weighted to the hilt on reappearance, being still on career-high mark
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Ended last season in good form on AW; has done most of her winning on turf but looks weighted to the hilt on reappearance, being still on a career-high mark; seems unlikely to improve aged eight.

comment: Hindered by wide draw last time, otherwise has a good record over 5f
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Very productive in 2025, winning five times; hindered by wide draw at Chester most recently, otherwise has a good record over 5f; just needs to prove he can overcome current mark.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Roach Power', 'horse_id': 3638598, 'quote': "He just needed the race first time out at Doncaster and he's in good form now. He's won over seven furlongs, but he's quick and is just as good at six furlongs. 23-04-24"}]

comment: Lacks recent match practice and remains on career-high mark
race_name: Sustainable Food Trust Handicap
spotlight: Lacks recent match practice, remains on career-high mark and won't have her apparent ideal ground (good to firm) unless the weather lends her a big hand; not the percentage call.

comment: Inexperience evident when third on last month's debut; could have lots more to offer
race_name: Newsells Park Stud Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Inexperience evident when 5l third of six at 10-1 behind odds-on stablemate on last month's debut at Kempton (1m3f, AW); from a classy family and could have lots more to offer for her leading yard; key player.

comment: Well-bred Godolphin newcomer; leading trainer also saddles Kempton third Fashion's Fancy
race_name: Newsells Park Stud Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Third foal; Frankel half-sister to 1m2f/1m4f winner Spirited Style (including Listed); dam 1m/1m2f Group 1 winner; could have a big part to play on debut, especially if strong in the betting; leading trainer also saddles Kempton third Fashion's Fancy.

comment: Promise on both starts and this Irish Oaks entry might not be far away
race_name: Newsells Park Stud Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: Kept on for promising second on debut at Yarmouth (1m, good to soft) last October and reappeared with 8l fifth of ten in strong novice at Sandown (1m2f, good) four weeks ago; entered in the Irish Oaks; might not be far away.

comment: Stayed on for fourth on 7f AW debut last December; this longer trip should be a firm plus
race_name: Newsells Park Stud Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: 13-2 when staying on for 4l fourth of eight on debut at Kempton (7f, AW) last December; her dam was a 1m/1m2f Group 1 winner in Peru and the step up in trip should be a firm plus for this Study Of Man filly; chance.

comment: 210,000euros yearling; shaped as though she would improve for debut run; one to consider
race_name: Newsells Park Stud Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: 210,000euros yearling with an attractive pedigree; shaped as though she would improve for the run when fourth of seven at 9-2 on last month's debut at Wetherby (1m2f, good to firm) and she's one to consider.

comment: In top hands but always behind when 20-1 for last month's debut at Nottingham
race_name: Newsells Park Stud Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
spotlight: In top hands and her dam was a Listed winner; she's one to watch in the betting on this second start but she was always behind when 20-1 for last month's debut at Nottingham (8.3f, good) and dramatic improvement is needed.

comment: 450,000gns yearling whose top northern trainer has made another fine start with his 2yos
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 85,000euros foal, 450,000gns yearling; by Minzaal; third foal; closely related to winners Turn On The Jets (5f including 2yo; RPR 112) and Saratoga Special (5f Listed); dam 5f winner (103); represents powerful northern yard that has made another fine start with 2yos; firmly in calculations on debut.

comment: Chester runner-up; takes on some very interesting newcomers but sets useful form standard
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: Improved upon last month's debut sixth at Newmarket (5f, good) when going close at Chester (5.5f good) a fortnight ago, shaping as though she would be suited by today's extra yardage; takes on some very interesting newcomers but sets a useful form standard for them to aim at.

comment: 400,000gns 2yo breeze-up buy; Newmarket trainer does well with his 2yos here
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 130,000euros yearling, 400,000gns 2yo breeze-ups; first foal; dam unplaced 6f/1m 2yo in US, sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Aktabantay, half-sister to winners Baydar (smart 1m-1m2f) and Reina Madre (French 7f Group 3), out of 1m2f Listed winner; Newmarket trainer is 5-14 (36%) with his 2yos here; this No Nay Never newcomer could play a leading role.

comment: £190,000 yearling; makes debut; trainer's last two 2yo runners here have both won
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: £190,000 yearling; third foal; dam 7f/1m winner (including Swedish Listed), half-sister to two French winners out of 1m winner; has travelled from Lambourn for her debut and trainer's last two 2yo runners here have both won.

comment: Dam 6f winner (including 2yo/Group 2); likely to improve for this debut but could run well
owner: Lord Lloyd Webber & W S Farish
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: Second foal; No Nay Never half-sister to 7f AW winner Champion Again Ole (RPR 86); dam 6f winner (including 2yo/Group 2), from talented family; likely to improve for this debut run but could give good account.

comment: Trainer has already unearthed some useful 2yos this year; one to be interested in on debut
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 70,000gns yearling (150,000gns vendor 2yo breeze-ups); fifth foal; Sea The Stars sister to winners Layaleena (7f 2yo/1m; RPR 93) and Beccara Rose (1m; 86); well-bred dam once-raced (52); trainer has already unearthed some useful 2yos this season and she's one to be interested in on debut.

comment: 155,000euros yearling with an attractive pedigree; one of two newcomers for the yard
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 155,000euros yearling; eighth foal; Minzaal half-sister to four winners including Je Zous (1m/9.4f including 2yo/Group 3), I'll Have Another (7f-1m6f including 2yo; RPR 102) and Bucky Larson (7f/1m; 100); dam 10.6f winner (81); one of two newcomers for yard; could go well on debut; check betting.

comment: 95,000gns yearling; sister to 6f 2yo/1m winner Shout; no surprise to see good run on debut
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; third foal; Advertise sister to 6f 2yo/1m winner Shout (RPR 105), half-sister to 7.3f/1m winner Port Erin (83); dam French 7f/7.5f winner (89), half-sister to 6f Group 2 winner Overdose; one of two debutantes for the stable; no surprise to see a good run; betting may guide.

comment: Well beaten at 16-1 at Ascot recently and needs to be an entirely different proposition
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: £45,000 yearling who has an attractive pedigree and is open to improvement on this second start; however, she was well beaten at 16-1 at Ascot (5f, good) a fortnight ago and needs to be an entirely different proposition.

comment: Third foal; dam 8.6f AW winner (RPR 70); others newcomers make greater appeal on paper
owner: Peter Onslow & Mr & Mrs Gary Middlebrook
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: By Profitable; third foal; dam 8.6f AW winner (RPR 70), half-sister to useful winners Real Force (5f-7.5f including 2yo) and Real Gain (1m-1m2f including 2yo); others newcomers make greater appeal on paper.

comment: Newcomer; Sottsass half-sister to 10.6f AW winner (RPR 56); she may prefer a longer trip
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 18,000euros yearling; third foal; half-sister to 10.6f AW winner Lord Talbot (RPR 56); unraced dam closely related to 1m6f Listed winner Arya Tara, out of 1m2f winner; this Sottsass newcomer may prefer a longer trip.

comment: £15,000 2yo breeze-ups; half-sister to seven winners but she may be best watched on debut
race_name: Oakmere Homes Supporting Macmillan EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 10,000euros yearling, £15,000 2yo breeze-ups; tenth foal; Blackbeard half-sister to seven winners notably Stone Of Destiny (5f-6f; RPR 109), Stone Tornado (1m Listed) and Illusionist (5f-6f including 2yo; 97); she may be best watched on debut.

comment: Listed/Group 3 winner last August; near-miss in Listed race on reappearance; strong claims
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Listed winner at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last August and followed up in Group 3 at Deauville (6f, soft) 13 days later; reappeared with near-miss in Listed race at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) and has strong claims.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Rosy Affair', 'horse_id': 5172505, 'quote': "She performed much better in the second half of last year and we toyed with the idea of the Al Quoz Sprint in Dubai but decided to be patient. It was no surprise when she won a Group 3 in August and she's going to work back from midsummer targets. We'd love to get her to Royal Ascot and I'd imagine she'll start in a Listed race. 02-04-26"}]

comment: Listed/Group 3 winner last summer and she could improve for her recent return at Newmarket
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Listed/Group 3 wins at Naas last summer (6f, yielding/good) then unplaced in two Group 1s; underwhelming on recent return at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; behind two of these) but those who raced more prominently were favoured and she could improve for that run; versatile ground-wise; key player.

comment: Some solid form in defeat in Listed races and she could be thereabouts
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: 0-10 since winning on debut in August 2024 but she ran well in Listed races last August/September (various ground) and did likewise when fourth of nine on reappearance at Newmarket three weeks ago (6f, good to firm; Rosy Affair about 2l ahead in second); could be thereabouts.

comment: 7f Group 3 win in France last October but she's struggled there on both starts this season
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: 5-7 in 2yo season, a campaign that culminated with Group 3 win at Chantilly (7f, very soft); the drop back in trip could be a positive but she's been well beaten on both starts this season, most recently in the French 1,000 Guineas; carries a 5lb penalty and a major turnaround is needed.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Half Sovereign', 'horse_id': 7020448, 'quote': "Fetched a huge price at the sales and we're very grateful to Lady Bamford for sending her back to us. She was always a big, leggy two-year-old and she's gone forward physically and got stronger. She goes to Deauville on April 7 for a French Guineas trial [Prix Imprudence] and will go for the French Guineas if it all goes well. 31-03-26"}]

comment: Listed third at Ayr last September and she's not discounted back on slow ground
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: More than just not handling the track was amiss when she was last on her recent return at Newmarket (6f, good to firm); however, this lightly raced 4yo showed improved form when tackling soft ground at Ayr last September, finishing third in that 5.5f Listed race; not discounted back on slow ground.

comment: Fourth in Group 2 Lowther last August but tailed off in Ayr Group 3 on soft when last seen
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Won last summer on first two starts (6f, AW/good) before respectable fourth in the Group 2 Lowther at York (6f, good to firm); however, tailed off in Group 3 Firth of Clyde at Ayr (6f, soft) in September and she has something to prove on the forecast slow ground on this reappearance.

comment: 2-2; steep rise in grade today but it remains to be seen where her limitations lie
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Impressive at Beverley (5f, soft) last September on sole 2yo start and readily justified odds-on favouritism in four-runner Pontefract novice (6f, good) last month; this is a steep rise in grade but it remains to be seen where her limitations lie; she's one to consider.

comment: Progressive 2yo last year; open to further improvement but it's very much necessary today
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last October and took another step forward when sixth of 19 in Listed race at Newmarket later that month (6f, good; unraced on softer); with a good trainer and she's open to further improvement, but it's very much necessary today.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Coconut Cove', 'horse_id': 7935113, 'quote': "She's tidy and will probably start off in the Listed Chelmer Fillies' Stakes at Chelmsford over six furlongs. She went close to getting black type last season. If we can secure that this term, it will be deemed a successful year. 01-04-26"}]

comment: Not beaten far in the Fred Darling on reappearance; each-way chance back on slow ground
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Ran four times in last year's 2yo campaign and best form came over 6f on soft/heavy ground, with a Group 3 fourth at Ayr and a Listed second at Doncaster; not beaten far when seventh of 14 at 66-1 on reappearance in the Group 3 Fred Darling at Newbury (7f, good); each-way chance back on slow ground.

comment: Kept on for fifth of 14 in Bath Listed race (5f); the return to 6f can suit; not ruled out
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Completed 6f Newmarket handicap hat-trick last summer (good to firm); kept on well for fifth of 14 in Listed race at Bath (5f, good) last month and close third in handicap there (5f, good) latest; has run well on heavy ground here; improvement needed but the return to 6f can suit; not ruled out.

comment: Went close in Group 3 at Newmarket last August but well beaten on both starts this spring
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Went close in Group 3 Sweet Solera at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last August and again ran well when fourth of five in Group 2 at Longchamp (1m, soft) in September; however, well beaten in Group 3/Listed races (7f/6f, good) on her two starts this spring and has to get back on track.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Princess Petrol', 'horse_id': 7762472, 'quote': "She did very well last year and was unlucky not to win the Sweet Solera Stakes at Newmarket. She hasn't progressed a great deal physically, but she's been training well and she was coming with a bit of a run on the toughest part of the track in the Fred Darling until she got knocked sideways. She was a bit gassy but hopefully that run has blown the cobwebs away. We'll probably go for a Listed race next and try to get that all-important stakes win. 22-04-26"}]

comment: Listed third at Newmarket last October but heavily beaten in Group 3 at Newbury on return
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: All five starts on good ground; easily made all in C&D maiden last October on third outing and third of 19 in Listed race at Newmarket (6f, good) a fortnight later; she's much better than she showed on her reappearance at Newbury but was heavily beaten; others arrive with more pressing claims.

comment: Solid profile in h'caps prior to a blip last time; up against it even if back to her best
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Steadily progressive in turf handicaps last season and reappeared with encouraging third at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; however, well beaten at Newmarket since and looks up against it today even if back to her best.

comment: Two-time winner in France but not at the top of her game in Britain this spring
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Two-time winner in France, the latest last November; however, others have stronger form and she hasn't been at the top of her game this spring on her first two runs in Britain.

comment: Exposed 6yo who goes up in grade this afternoon and would be a shock winner
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Admirable 6yo who has won eight of her 52 starts (including on soft); however, she goes up in grade this afternoon and would be a shock winner.

comment: Came up short in Listed race and two nurseries towards end of last season; hard to fancy
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Won Chester novice (6f, good to soft) last September on fourth run but came up short in Listed race and two nurseries subsequently; hard to fancy.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Trust Amy', 'horse_id': 7748965, 'quote': "A nice, sharp filly with plenty of pace who was bought from the breeze-ups a year ago. She looks good and is very exciting. She's settled down a lot from her two-year-old year. She's not over-big but she's a pocket rocket. She'll go to Chester as her owner Simon Boucher loves it there. We're looking for somewhere at the end of the month to get her started. 08-04-26"}]

comment: French AW conditions race winner for Amy Murphy; improvement needed on stable debut
race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Cecil Frail Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: All five starts have been in France; won conditions race at Chantilly (6.5f, AW) last October and signed off for Amy Murphy with fifth of 13 in Listed race there (6.5f. AW) in March; improvement needed on stable debut (remains in same ownership).

comment: Trainer is enjoying an excellent spring with his 2yos; could play a leading role on debut
race_name: Oakmere Homes Together For Macmillan EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 19,000gns foal, 55,000gns yearling; sixth foal; Perfect Power half-brother to US 5.5f-6.5f winner Philipsburg; dam unraced half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Shadn, out of 7f Listed winner; trainer is enjoying an excellent spring with his 2yos and this one could play a leading role on debut.

comment: Second on last week's debut (5.7f); mixed messages in pedigree regarding this sort of trip
race_name: Oakmere Homes Together For Macmillan EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 4-5 favourite when no match for the winner in second of five on last Wednesday's debut at Bath (5.7f, firm); there are mixed messages in his pedigree regarding the suitability of today's step up in trip but he's open to improvement and is entitled to respect.

comment: Late headway on last week's debut over 5f at Salisbury and the step up to 7f may well suit
race_name: Oakmere Homes Together For Macmillan EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 10-1 and hampered leaving the stalls when fourth of six, beaten just over 5l, on last Thursday's debut at Salisbury (5f, good); he made some late headway and, with his dam being a 7f 2yo winner, he's open to improvement at this longer trip; interesting, all the more so if well backed.

comment: There's plenty of potential in his pedigree and he could be a contender on debut
race_name: Oakmere Homes Together For Macmillan EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 60,000gns yearling; 11th foal; Sea The Moon brother to 1m4f Australian Group 1 winner Durston, half-brother to four winners including Cubanita (1m-1m4f including 2yo/Group 3) and Aquarium (7f-1m2f; RPR 109); there's plenty of potential in his pedigree and he could be a contender on debut.

comment: Two 1m2f wins on Lingfield AW this year but he accomplished little in his three turf races
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Off the mark in February, at the 16th attempt, and he narrowly justified favouritism last month as well; both of those races were over 1m2f but on Lingfield AW and he's accomplished little in his three turf races, the latest on penultimate start; others therefore look more solid.

comment: Pretty reliable; second of 14 at Doncaster (1m2f, good to soft) in March last time
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: 1m2f wins last year at Pontefract (good) in June and Newcastle (AW) in December; pretty reliable and second of 14 at Doncaster (1m2f, good to soft) on return to turf in March showed again that he should be seriously involved.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Golspie', 'horse_id': 5017666, 'quote': 'This colt made a winning start to his career when taking a mile maiden at Newbury, when I thought he had a good chance. Last time out I sent him to Newmarket for his handicap debut but the ground was too fast. When he won it was soft and we have learned that he must have plenty of give underfoot to be his best. I think he is on a nice mark (81) when the ground is right. 11-07-23'}]

comment: 5 races; first tongue-tie when winning at Kempton (1m, AW) last April by a head; off since
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who took a big step forward in first-time tongue-tie when landing a 1m handicap on Kempton AW last April by a head; that win was gained with a late challenge (sole attempt at 1m2f was debut) but he's been absent since, which probably poses the biggest question.

comment: Struggled badly in four handicaps last term but reappeared with a closer finish (1m2f, AW)
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Unraced on softer than good; struggled badly in her four handicaps last season but reappeared with a closer finish when fourth of ten at Lingfield (1m2f, AW; 16-1) late last month; needs to build on that.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Blue Wonder', 'horse_id': 6988874, 'quote': "She's nice. She's been second twice and wasn't beaten far last time at Haydock behind Previse. She just needs the rub of the green to get her head in front and could go back to Haydock on Friday. 29-05-25"}]

comment: In good form last May-July; player if he can stay 1m2f, which isn't nailed on
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: In good form last May-July, winning at Carlisle (1m, soft) and runner-up on four occasions, including there at 1m1f on soft; never dangerous on reappearance 15 days ago, which also happened at the same juncture last term before a good run next time; player if he can stay 1m2f, which isn't nailed on.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Bellasio', 'horse_id': 5327074, 'quote': "We've always thought he was a talented horse and he's come back in great form after nearly a year off. He won at Carlisle in June and has finished second four times, which is very frustrating, but he's more than capable off his mark. Soft ground is pretty key so he's had a midsummer break in preparation for an autumn campaign running into the all-weather. He's got 10lb in hand if we can get him right on the day. 04-09-25"}]

comment: Won from front at Doncaster (1m2f, soft; 6lb higher today) in October; needs a second look
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Ninth start when off the mark in game fashion from the front at Doncaster (1m2f, soft; 6lb higher today) in October under Ben Ffrench Davis; out of the handicap when appearing to run well 11 days later (1m2f, good) and he needs a second look on this reappearance.

comment: Best turf efforts when placed here but his three AW runs this spring were rather muted
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: All three wins were on AW, at up to 1m3f; best turf efforts when placed at this track last August/September but his three AW runs this spring were rather muted; has career-low mark but needs to perk up.

comment: The ground was softer than good for his 1m1f/1m2f wins last term; one to consider
owner: Gordon Bulloch & S Hardcastle D Szepler
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Won handicaps last season when always prominent at Carlisle (1m1f, good to soft) in May and Beverley (1m2f, soft) in September; no show when 14-1 for reappearance one month ago, his first race on good to firm, but it's not hard to think he will be a lot more potent today.

comment: Reappearance was probably a step back up the ladder; lacks any win for exactly two years
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Lost his way in the autumn; has a favourable mark as a result and reappearance six weeks ago (without usual cheekpieces, which now return) was probably a step back up the ladder, but there's been no win for exactly two years.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Pol Roger', 'horse_id': 4449797, 'quote': "He went up 4lb to 74 after his last win at Ayr in May but then he's finished second in his last four races and has gone up another 7lb to 81. I'm thinking we need to change something and maybe try him over a bit further - he's been running over 1m2f - as he clearly looks to be in the handicapper's grip over that trip. 28-08-24"}]

comment: Reverts to 1m2f and probably okay on the ground, so he's considered each-way
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Placed on three of five starts this year; wide draw no help at Chester two weeks ago when he had his first crack at 1m4f (tailed off); reverts to 1m2f and probably okay on the ground, so he's considered each-way.

comment: Eight-race maiden who's not lived up to initial promise; up from 1m and stamina in family
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has not lived up to initial promise; he's now 10lb lower than his opening mark but has not shown enough this term; moves up from 1m and there is stamina in the family.

comment: Nine-race maiden who ended last term with two poor shows; left Brian Meehan for 15,000gns
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: Nine-race maiden who ended last term with two poor shows, with blinkers given a go on final outing; subsequently left Brian Meehan for 15,000gns in October; has a piece of 1m2f form, but below form on his only start on softer than good and non-runner for old yard when the ground was testing.

comment: Veteran who is only 2-55 (last win 2022); well handicapped on some 1m6f form last season
race_name: Oakmere Homes Racing For Macmillan Handicap
spotlight: 10yo who's 2-55, with last win in 2022; well handicapped on some 1m6f form last term and probably needed recent run, but whether he can be competitive at this trip nowadays remains to be seen.

comment: Big run is probably on its way after a promising 1m2f fourth at Sandown on handicap debut
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Third at Newbury (1m, soft) last October was his best form as 2yo and there was promise in his never-dangerous but staying-on fourth of six on handicap/seasonal debut at Sandown (1m2f, good; 6-1 from 8-1) four weeks ago; a big run is probably on its way.

comment: Up 7lb for this turf debut but there was plenty to like about his Newcastle win (1m2f, AW)
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Well held in three 7f AW runs late last year but second favourite with the visor enlisted for handicap/seasonal debut at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) three weeks ago, coming from towards rear to win comfortably in the end; up 7lb and makes turf debut but he has to be in serious calculations.

comment: Won handicap/seasonal debut at Redcar (1m, good to firm) with a strong finish; up 7lb
owner: Middleham Park Racing Lxvi And P Demilow
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: 11-2 when seen in a very new light for handicap/seasonal debut at Redcar (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, coming from rear to win a nine-runner race by nearly 2l going away; 7lb higher but there was plenty of encouragement for 1m2f in that performance; one to consider.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Ephron', 'horse_id': 8009426, 'quote': "He won last week at Redcar on his first run in a handicap. He was very immature last year - his owners Middleham Park Racing were very patient with him and they got their rewards last week. His home work had been good but I wasn't that sure he'd be able to cope with the ground that fast, so it was very pleasing that he won. He looks like he'll stay 1m2f and he'd be a lot happier when there's more juice in the ground too, so hopefully there'll be a bit more to come from him. I'm looking forward to him for the rest of the season. 06-05-26"}]

comment: Best effort on debut but this is a new trip for handicap debut; with a powerful yard
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Fifth of ten at Newbury (1m, soft) in October on debut but he's not lived up to that promise in his two races since; admittedly 16-1 for last month's Wetherby reappearance (1m, good to firm) behind an odds-on stablemate; this is also a new trip for handicap debut, representing a powerful yard.

comment: Won at Nottingham (1m, good); set a steady pace when trying 1m2f at Goodwood (good; 4th)
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Big step forward on handicap debut when scoring at Nottingham (1m, good) last month; set a steady pace when trying 1m2f at Goodwood (good) three weeks ago, resulting in a creditable fourth of seven but she clearly needs to build on that.

comment: Looked capable of better as 2yo; wind and gelding operations this spring; one to check out
owner: All For One Racing Ix & Chris Wright
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Placed twice in the mud last September (made most on second occasion) before running on but never getting in a serious blow when 13-8 favourite for handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in November, still looking capable of better; had wind and gelding operations this spring; one to check out for a yard which had two notable well-backed winners last week.

comment: Minor honours this term and 1m2f now looks in order (backed up by pedigree); place claims
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Finished well when scoring on handicap debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in December; ran creditably for minor honours in her two starts this season, over 1m on good and good to firm, after which 1m2f now looks in order (backed up by pedigree); place claims.

comment: While not disgraced on handicap/turf debut (1m2f, good to firm), much better is needed
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Staying-on third of six in maiden at Chelmsford (1m2f, AW) in March was best effort; while not disgraced when fourth of nine on handicap/turf debut at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) four weeks ago, much better is needed.

comment: Returned to turf when tailed off at Newmarket (1m2f, good; 40-1) latest; caution advised
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Handicap debut winner at Wolverhampton (upped to 9.4f, AW) in November but ran poorly both starts since, returned to turf when tailed off at Newmarket (1m2f, good; 40-1) latest; down in class but caution advised.

comment: Maybe he needed his stable/seasonal debut (25-1) but others have more pressing claims
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Seven races last year for David Loughnane and sole win in a Wolverhampton nursery (8.6f, AW) in October in first-time cheekpieces, which were kept when never dangerous in his two starts since; latest was stable/seasonal debut (25-1) and maybe he needed that run, but others have more pressing claims.

comment: Faded when favourite for handicap/seasonal debut and latest run was a good deal worse
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: 7.4f Beverley maiden winner (good to firm; acts on soft) from four 2yo starts; faded when favourite for handicap/seasonal debut there in April and her Doncaster 1m run three weeks ago was a good deal worse, so she's best watched for the time being.

comment: Remote last of eight at Chester (1m4f, good; 80-1) on British debut 15 days ago
race_name: racingtv.com Handicap
spotlight: Showed ability in two of his three maiden races in Ireland but well beaten on handicap debut there (1m) in October and a remote last of eight at Chester (1m4f, good; 80-1) on British debut 15 days ago; cheekpieces (worn for his last two Irish starts) return.

comment: The first-time hood could help him settle; no ground issues; might be in with a chance
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: Six-race maiden who tackles 1m for the first time and could do with settling better, but the first-time hood could help in that regard and he kept on when fifth of 11 at Lingfield (7f, AW) last time; effective on soft/heavy ground last year and he might be in with a chance.

comment: Two backward steps since going close on debut; chance if tapping back into initial promise
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: All three starts over 1m on AW; runner-up on debut at Newcastle in February; two backward steps have followed but he could be a contender if tapping back into his initial promise on this handicap/turf debut.

comment: Ran okay when fifth of 13 at the Curragh and this Irish raider could be in the shake-up
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: 0-5 and yet to pose a serious threat but he ran fairly well from the front when fifth of 13 in a handicap at the Curragh (1m, soft) last month; he's travelled from Ireland to race today and could be in the shake-up.

comment: Disappointing favourite last time but not ruled out given previous promise; handicap debut
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: Disappointing favourite in Southwell novice (7f, AW) last month but short-headed in Newcastle maiden (7f, AW) previously; bred to be suited by this step up in trip and he's not ruled out on handicap debut.

comment: Beaten a long way on reappearance but may have needed it; went close in his sole nursery
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: Beaten a long way on reappearance at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) four weeks ago and it's hard to be confident on the back of that; however, he may have needed the run and he was a close second of five at Redcar (1m, good) last November in his sole nursery; a case can be made on that form.

comment: No threat at Newmarket latest after a break but could have part to play back down in grade
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: Reared at the start and couldn't get into it at Newmarket (7f, good) last month when back from a break; won a four-runner nursery at Newcastle (7f, AW) in December on his first run since being gelded and he drops back in grade today; could have a part to play.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Senor Campanaro', 'horse_id': 7947756, 'quote': "He eventually broke his maiden in a nursery at Newcastle in December and has done well from two to three. The Rowley Mile course didn't suit him on his return and he'll be better on a more conventional track. He'll stay a bit further and should progress. 22-04-26"}]

comment: Won nicely at Wolverhampton in March; soundly beaten in midfield at Kempton on Wednesday
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: Off the mark at the seventh attempt with an improved performance at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in March; did it nicely on that occasion but he was soundly beaten in mid-division at Kempton (1m, AW) on Wednesday.

comment: Hasn't shone this spring but the drop back in trip and return to slower ground may help
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: Promising third at Bath (1m, soft) last October on second start and runner-up in Newcastle nursery (7f, AW) next time; she hasn't shone on her two runs this spring (1m/1m2f, good/good to firm) but the drop back in trip and return to slower ground may help.

comment: Six-race maiden who is starting to look exposed; can be headstrong and goes up in trip
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: She ran okay when fourth of 11 behind a comfortable winner at Southwell (7f, AW) a fortnight ago on reappearance; however, this six-race maiden is starting to look exposed and she can be headstrong, which is a concern on this first crack at 1m.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Yorkshire Queen', 'horse_id': 7493137, 'quote': "She made a good start last week. I felt she was the best horse in the race despite not winning. We may pull her back to 6f next time, but equally she's all right over seven as long as it's not too stiff. We're going to try to win a maiden and then go to the restricted series final at Goodwood, which we won last year with Love Talk. She's a nice filly who will be better again next year. 04-09-25"}]

comment: 200-1 fourth at Kempton last month and he's one to consider on this handicap debut
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: Made debut in February and his three starts have been on AW; improved form when fourth of 13 at 200-1 over 1m at Kempton last month, behind three useful opponents; one to consider on handicap debut.

comment: 0-6 at up to 7f and yet to finish better than fourth but has hinted 1m will be a good fit
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: Six-race maiden who is yet to finish better than fourth but there were hints of promise in 7f nurseries here (good/good to soft; unraced on softer) last September and the way he kept on when mid-division on his recent reappearance at Southwell (7f, AW) suggests 1m could be a good fit.

comment: 13 races and has won just once (last May) but this first crack at 1m is worth a go
race_name: Oakmere Homes Green Ribbon Handicap
spotlight: She's raced 13 times and won just once (last May); also unproven on slow ground; however, she kept on galloping when sixth of 11 over 7f at Newmarket three weeks ago and this first crack at 1m is worth a go.

comment: 1m6f seemed the best fit last year; perhaps in need of the race on return four weeks ago
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: 1m6f seemed the best fit last year, including for a win at Yarmouth (good) in June and also when first past the post at this track (firm; demoted after bumping) in July; perhaps in need of the race when last of five on return four weeks ago and he needs a second look back here.

comment: Won here (11.5f, firm) nine days ago, leading over 1f out for a 5l win in six-runner race
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: Bumper/hurdles winner who's had another crack at the Flat on last two outings and scored here (11.5f, firm) nine days ago, leading over 1f out for a 5l win in six-runner race; penalty leaves her 3lb well-in compared to future handicaps and she's one for the shortlist.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Basilette', 'horse_id': 4730073, 'quote': "She's on a winter break. She's a summer filly - she won two hurdle races in October and loves Stratford for some reason. Her Flat handicap mark is very low (49), so when she comes back into training in February we'll wait until the ground has good, or even good to firm in it, and then she will mix and match Flat and hurdling for the summer. 21-01-26"}]

comment: AW classified winner who  has some turf form in the bumper and hurdle spheres
owner: Alan Jamieson Site Services & G L Moore
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: 17 races, finishing well in a 1m4f classified at Lingfield (AW) in March for her only win; second there off today's mark at same track (2m) last time was her best form under Flat rules and she has some turf form in the bumper and hurdle spheres; not entirely ruled out on Flat turf debut.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Everest', 'horse_id': 5977949, 'quote': "We like this mare and she could be a nice prospect. We thought we'd go to Southwell in June and win but couldn't believe the depth of the race at that time of year. She hadn't been hard pressed for that and in the end found one too good but it was a promising run. She ran a nice enough race at Cheltenham on Saturday for her first run back and we'll try to find another bumper for her. She'll possibly go back to Cheltenham for the Paddy Power meeting. 29-10-24"}]

comment: 2lb below last winning mark; two respectable shows this term; one to take seriously
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: Had 1m4f and 1m6f wins on consecutive starts last summer and she's now 2lb below her last winning mark; following two respectable shows over 1m4f this term, she is one to take seriously on this return to 1m6f.

comment: New trip might offer hope on first run since 18,000gns sale (left H Charlton) in October
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: Upped in trip and 11-10 favourite when weakening into third of six on handicap debut at Southwell (2m, AW) in September but that is the best form from his five starts; has otherwise not gone beyond 1m4f (tried in cheekpieces on final outing) so today's new trip might offer hope on this first run since 18,000gns sale out of Harry Charlton's last October.

comment: Veteran whose two 2025 wins were at this track; last week's hurdles run was disappointing
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: Veteran whose two 2025 wins were at this track over 1m6f and 1m5f; placed twice over hurdles last November but last week's run in that sphere (after a Flat reappearance here) was disappointing and dents his appeal.

comment: Won twice on fast ground last May; recent reappearance was a step back in right direction
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: Won on fast ground last May at Salisbury (1m6f) and Bath (11.5f); tailed off later that month but his recent reappearance here was a step back in the right direction; each-way claims if he's come on from that run.

comment: Off the boil January-March and no revival 15 days ago; a major player if back on song
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: 37 starts, with her only wins coming last year on AW in February and at Ffos Las (1m6f, good) in July; went off the boil this January-March and no revival 15 days ago, after a break, but she'd be a major player if back on song.

comment: Below form lately; raced freely when behind here on sole go beyond 1m4f (1m5f last year)
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: Sole win (19 starts) was over 1m2f at Ffos Las last June; has the same mark today, having finished no better than sixth in his four races since, two of them this season; raced freely when behind here on his only attempt beyond 1m4f (1m5f last September) so there are enough doubts.

comment: Has not come up to scratch at 1m4f-2m1f in her four handicaps, first three for M Tregoning
race_name: Download The Fairplay App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
spotlight: Has not come up to scratch over 1m4f-2m1f in her four handicaps (trained last year by Marcus Tregoning, 2026 reappearance with this yard) and two of those were at this track, but she has fallen 9lb in the process.

comment: Blinkered for Lingfield debut (1m2f, AW) but won; the clear form pick and should improve
race_name: MJ Church Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
spotlight: By Decorated Knight; first foal of an unraced half-sister to dual 1m2f Group 3 winner Extra Elusive and the yard's Group 2 Gimcrack winner Ajaya; 10-1 and blinkered for debut in 12-runner maiden at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) late last month but she was always close up and kept on stoutly to lead in the final strides; the clear form pick in this field and should improve.

comment: 5-6 for workmanlike novice win at Lingfield (1m, AW) in December; bred more for this trip
race_name: MJ Church Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
spotlight: Showed promise on debut last October and justified 5-6 favouritism in 12-runner novice at Lingfield (again 1m on AW) in December; the latter was in workmanlike style but she's bred more for this trip and is open to further improvement, which is needed.

comment: 2nd of eight to impressive red-hot favourite in a novice at Kempton (1m3f, AW) 16 days ago
race_name: MJ Church Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
spotlight: Modest form in a small field at Newmarket (7f, good) in April but second of eight to an impressive red-hot favourite in novice at Kempton (1m3f, AW) three weeks later; similar form to most of these and could improve again.

comment: Madrisa was 8l ahead at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) last time and reopposes; major work to do
race_name: MJ Church Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
spotlight: 50-1 when never-dangerous seventh of 12 in maiden at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) last month, which was better than her December debut but winner Madrisa was 8l ahead at Lingfield and reopposes; major work to do despite revised terms.

comment: Finished behind two of these rivals when 12-1 in a maiden at Lingfield (1m2f, AW
race_name: MJ Church Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
spotlight: Dam useful at 1m2f-1m4f but this daughter was a 1,000gns yearling and finished behind two of these rivals when 12-1 in a maiden at Lingfield (1m2f, AW).

comment: Showed little when 25-1 in a novice at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to firm) one month ago
race_name: MJ Church Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
spotlight: Interesting on pedigree but she showed little when 25-1 in a five-runner novice at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to firm) one month ago.

comment: No worthwhile form in a bumper, a 1m novice or a 1m2f maiden
race_name: MJ Church Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)
