spotlight: No worthwhile form in a bumper, a 1m novice or when behind three of today's rivals in a 1m2f maiden.

comment: Raced front rank when third at Newbury and second at Newmarket; latter sets high standard
race_name: Wiltshire And Bath Air Ambulance Raceday 15th July British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: Third of nine in a maiden at Newbury (5f, good) 16 days before her second of seven in a novice at Newmarket (5f, good to firm); raced front rank on both occasions and sets a high standard on the latter form.

comment: £180,000 breeze-up 2yo; bred for speed and the stable's 2yos have made an impact this term
race_name: Wiltshire And Bath Air Ambulance Raceday 15th July British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 82,000gns foal, £180,000 breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; Mehmas half-brother to 6f/7f winner Thurso (RPR 83); dam 5f winner (including Listed; 95), half-sister to a useful 5f/5.5f winner and out of Italian 5f Listed winner; bred for speed and the stable's 2yos have already made an impact this term.

comment: 80,000euros yearling, £140,000 breeze-up 2yo by Minzaal; needs to be good in this field
race_name: Wiltshire And Bath Air Ambulance Raceday 15th July British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: 80,000euros yearling, £140,000 breeze-up 2yo; third foal; Minzaal half-sister to 5.5f/6f winner Spiritualism (including 2yo; RPR 74); dam 7f winner (68), half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 2 winner/1,000 Guineas runner-up Lucida, out of half-sister to Breeders' Cup Turf winner English Channel; first 2yo of the season for her stable and she needs to be good.

comment: 5th of ten at Chester (5,5f, good) latest, showing plenty of speed in face of widest draw
race_name: Wiltshire And Bath Air Ambulance Raceday 15th July British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: Unable to justify favouritism over C&D (good) on debut; fifth of ten in maiden at Chester (5.5f, good) over four weeks later was better form, showing plenty of speed in the face of the widest draw; bold show seems likely but Jaan Ki Tikri looks a tough rival.

comment: Made most when third of six at Salisbury (5f, good) but others in this have shown more
race_name: Wiltshire And Bath Air Ambulance Raceday 15th July British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
spotlight: Dam US 5.5f turf 2yo winner; this daughter made most when third of six in a maiden at Salisbury (5f, good) eight days ago, despite starting 80-1, but two others in today's race have shown more.

comment: Triple course winner who has finished close up here in her last two runs; respected
race_name: Prix De Charlotte Fillies' Handicap
spotlight: Triple course winner who scored at Wolverhampton in March and she's gone close back at this track (5f/5,6f, firm) in last two runs; only 1lb higher than for her runner-up effort three weeks ago and she should make another bold bid.

comment: All three wins have been on AW but she's been knocking on the door here in last two starts
race_name: Prix De Charlotte Fillies' Handicap
spotlight: All three wins have been on AW but she's been knocking on door here (5f, firm/good) in last two starts; nudged up 2lb but she's been as good as ever in her last two runs and should be in the thick of things again.

comment: Scored here in final 3yo run and she started this season with another C&D win; key player
race_name: Prix De Charlotte Fillies' Handicap
spotlight: Scored here in (good to soft) in her final 3yo run and she started this campaign with another brave win over C&D (firm) last month; that took her Bath record to 2-2 and she's remains feasibly treated off only 2lb higher; key player.

comment: Disappointing on Newmarket reappearance and she needs to bounce back near best
race_name: Prix De Charlotte Fillies' Handicap
spotlight: Clearcut winner of a Windsor novice (6f, good to firm) last June; finished close up in three of her four handicaps last season but she reappeared with a 12l defeat at Newmarket (100-30) three weeks ago; that was in a Class 3 after six months off but she needs to bounce back after that disappointing run.

comment: Four-time AW winner but she's 0-11 on turf and has been quiet in both runs this season
race_name: Prix De Charlotte Fillies' Handicap
spotlight: All four wins have been on AW and she's 0-11 on turf; finished placed a few times on good or quicker ground last summer but she's been quiet in both runs this season and others are more persuasive.
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Queue Dos', 'horse_id': 6037314, 'quote': "She's for the same owners as Queues Likely and I think she's going to be very good. I think she'll definitely end up a black-type filly, most likely over a mile or seven furlongs. I was pleased with the way she ran at Bath because I thought she'd run a nice race as she'd been working lovely at home. Her half-brother was second in the Brocklesby and was sold to America straight away after that. He has run well in a big race in America and it's going to end up quite a nice page. She's got the size and scope. 04-07-24"}]

comment: Triple turf winner but she's been out of sorts in two runs for new yard this season
race_name: Prix De Charlotte Fillies' Handicap
spotlight: Triple turf winner who scored at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last July in her final run for Tom Dascombe; only 1lb higher than for that success but she's been out of sorts in two runs for new yard this spring and needs to get back on track.

comment: Catterick winner who is still unexposed and needs a close look on handicap/seasonal debut
race_name: Blackmore Build And Design Handicap
spotlight: Unexposed filly who made all when landing a Catterick maiden (5f, soft; 7-2) last October; that was a very narrow success but she looks on a fair opening mark and should have more to offer as a 3yo; respected on handicap/seasonal debut
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Control Room', 'horse_id': 8058118, 'quote': "She won at Catterick on her final start of last season. She did her final piece of work the other day and worked very nicely. I think she's quite handily weighted - and she has grown in strength over the winter. She'll get 6f no problem but I think we'll start her over 5f. She could run quite well on her seasonal debut, which could be this week, probably at Bath. She's run there before and finished second. 20-05-26"}]

comment: Improved form dropped to 6f when winning on handicap debut at Windsor; respected up 2lb
race_name: Blackmore Build And Design Handicap
spotlight: Improved form dropped to 6f on handicap debut when scoring under a prominent ride at Windsor (good to firm) 18 days ago; that was a narrow success at 33-1 but he's only 2lb higher here and is still unexposed after only four starts; respected.

comment: Seven-race maiden and he needs to raise his game back up in trip
owner: K Hunter D Leon And Hunscote Stud Ltd
race_name: Blackmore Build And Design Handicap
spotlight: Didn't progress in six 2yo runs for Charlie Hills and was only sixth of ten when favourite on recent stable debut at Windsor (5f, good to firm); may have needed that run but he needs to raise his game back up in trip.

comment: Five-race maiden who left Richard Hannon for 6,000gns in November; bit to prove on return
race_name: Blackmore Build And Design Handicap
spotlight: Promising third in a soft-ground nursery at Thirsk (6f, soft) last September but she was well held here (5f, heavy) in final 2yo run; still lightly raced but she left Richard Hannon for 6,000gns in November and has bit to prove on her stable debut.

comment: Still lightly raced but he needs to resume his progress to defy this mark
race_name: Blackmore Build And Design Handicap
spotlight: Made it second-time lucky in handicaps when scoring at Kempton (6f, AW) in March but he couldn't make an impact at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 18 days ago; still lightly raced but he needs to resume his progress to defy this mark.

comment: Dual AW winner but she was a long way below form on Polytrack last time; down the list
race_name: Blackmore Build And Design Handicap
spotlight: Dual Tapeta winner for new yard this year but she's not easy to predict and her form has slumped in last two starts; has bit to prove again and she's not finished closer than fifth in six turf runs.

comment: Inconsistent filly who has a record of 1-11; comes with risks attached on return
race_name: Blackmore Build And Design Handicap
spotlight: Off the mark in a 5f Lingfield novice (good) last May; reached the frame in a couple of handicaps since but she's been hard to predict and was last of seven in her final run (6f, AW) last year; record is now 1-11 and comes with risks attached on her return; visor worn last time is removed.
